text: dsh-desktop-statusbar 是面向 DSH 桌面端的可配置状态栏插件。它把状态栏放在对话输入区下方，并提供独立设置页，可选择和拖动排序统计字段。状态栏展示上下文占用、轮次与工具调用、缓存命中、速度和耗时，并按模型价格估算本轮及会话费用；还可显示余额、峰谷用量和会话详情。用户可自定义模型价格与计价币种，适合希望在对话时查看运行状态、用量和费用的 DSH 桌面用户。余额查询依赖当前模型供应商的凭据。

dsh-desktop-statusbar adds a configurable status bar below the DSH composer. Choose and reorder fields for context, usage, timing, and estimated costs. A settings page supports custom model prices and currency; the bar can also show provider balance and session details.

I want to track estimated model costs and provider balance in the desktop UI.
底部状态栏与字段设置：在对话输入区下方显示可选统计字段，并在设置页调整字段显示和顺序。
会话运行统计：结合 DSH 会话投影计算上下文、token 用量、模型、耗时和调用统计，供状态栏及详情面板查看。
费用和余额查看：根据模型价格估算会话费用，并通过供应商适配器读取余额；价格可在设置页自定义。
峰谷计价辅助：读取节假日通知和汇率数据，为状态栏的费用展示提供节假日与币种换算信息。
dsh-desktop-statusbar 查询供应商余额、更新汇率和获取节假日信息时会连接相应外部服务；余额功能需 DSH 中已配置该供应商凭据。

Let me reorder the desktop status fields and hide the ones I do not use.

以一条可配置的状态栏替换 DSH 桌面端对话区底部的统计行：字段、顺序、模型单价与计价单位均可配置，费用按官方峰谷口径实时估算。

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 功能：- **9 个可选字段 + 栏首上下文圆环**：上下文占用（栏首圆环）、峰谷判断、轮次＆步数、缓存命中率、输出速度、首字平均、运行用时、本轮费用、总计费用、余额
- **点击字段可查看详情**：

| 字段 | 内容 |
  | --- | --- |
  | 上下文占用（栏首圆环） | 系统提示词 / 工具定义 / 对话消息 |
  | 峰谷判断 | 日 / 周 / 月 / 年数据统计热力图 |
  | 轮次＆步数 | 上下文压缩 / 技能注入 / 工具调用 |
  | 综合命中 | 本轮 / 最高 / 最低缓存命中率 |
  | 综合速度 | 本轮 / 最快 / 最慢速度 |
  | 首字平均 | 本轮 / 最快 / 最慢首字延迟 |
  | 运行用时 | 等待用时 / 模型用时 / 工具调用 |
  | 本轮费用 | 本轮会话的 token 明细 |
  | 总计费用 | 当前会话的累计 token 明细 |
  | 余额 | 充值余额 / 赠金余额 / 剩余配额 |

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 功能：- **会话数据下钻**：上下文压缩逐次标注发生节点，技能注入统计当前会话注入的技能，工具调用列出会话使用的所有工具与各自次数；点击标题返回上一层
- **版本自检与更新**：DSH 启动时自动检测最新版本，发现新版时在「状态栏」导航项旁显示提示，并在设置页提供一键更新按钮
- **费用估算**：按官方峰谷口径计价，每条调用按其发生时刻与所用模型分别计算
- **价格库**：自定义单价、峰谷分档、CNY / USD 计价单位
- **GitHub支持**：用户的支持是开发者持续开发的最大动力！点击按钮转跳GitHub项目页，帮忙点亮Star支持一下，感谢各位！
- **其他**：节假日日历一键更新、账户余额每分钟刷新、中英双语

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 安装：在 DSH 桌面端打开 **插件 → 添加插件**，输入包名后安装：

```
dsh-desktop-statusbar
```

网络受限时，可在同一对话框内将安装源切换为「中国大陆镜像源」。亦支持 GitHub 仓库地址：

```
https://github.com/raphael-y7/dsh-desktop-statusbar
```

命令行方式：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-desktop-statusbar
```

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 从 npm 安装：插件面板与命令行两种方式，安装源默认都是 npm registry，包名为 `dsh-desktop-statusbar`。想确认 npm 上的当前版本：

```powershell
npm view dsh-desktop-statusbar version
```

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 插件自带的更新失效时：插件里那个一键更新按钮，在某些桌面端版本上会失败（点了没反应、或者直接显示失败）。这时不要反复点，改用官方安装入口、**在包名后面加上 `@版本号`** 指定到具体版本，就能精确装上：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-desktop-statusbar@3.0.0
```

插件面板里同样可以这样填 —— 在「添加插件」的输入框里写 `dsh-desktop-statusbar@3.0.0`。

版本号填你看到的最新版本即可（发布页右侧的版本号，或上面那条 `npm view` 命令的输出）。带上版本号还有一个好处：**装上的就是你想要的那一版**，不会因为缓存拿到旧包。

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 使用：打开 **设置 → 状态栏**：

- **上下文占用**：栏首圆环，进度表示上下文占用比例，缺口表示上下文压缩阈值，颜色表示运行状态（空闲灰 / 运行绿 / 报错红 / 待审批黄）
- **统计字段**：勾选控制显示，取消勾选仅隐藏、不改变位置；拖动右侧把手调整顺序；「恢复默认设置」恢复出厂顺序并全选
- **自定义模型价格**：输入模型名并「添加」以新增条目；「修改」展开编辑区，保存后写入；需区分峰谷时段时勾选「峰谷计价」，否则按全天同价计算
- **计价单位**：价格编辑区右上角可选 CNY 或 USD。切换时内置的两款模型改用对应币种的官方参考价（已修改的条目保留），费用段的符号随之变化；余额按接口返回的币种显示
- **节假日**：点击「更新节假峰谷」获取并写入下一年的放假安排
- **余额**：每分钟自动刷新
dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 计费口径：高峰时段为**北京时间周一至周五 9:00-12:00、14:00-18:00**，空闲价为高峰价的一半；法定节假日与周末全天按空闲价计费（与[官方文档](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)一致，2026-09 核对）。

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 已知限制：- 最快 / 最慢首字与速度来自 host 新增的投影，**升级后需完全退出并重启 DSH** 才开始统计
- 价格库中缺少单价的模型不计费，补充单价后自动补算
- 一键更新依赖 pnpm 可执行文件：桌面端用宿主随包提供的 pnpm，命令行 / 网页端需要系统里有 `pnpm`。都找不到时会明确提示「找不到 pnpm」，并把**尝试过的每个位置**一并写进日志；也可以用环境变量 `DSH_DESKTOP_STATUSBAR_PNPM` 直接指定要用的命令

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 开发：每个测试都是独立脚本，直接用 node 跑，不需要任何测试框架。

```powershell
npm test          # runs every verify*.js under tests/, then checks project vs installed plugin dir
npm run sync      # copies lib/ into the installed plugin dir
```

`tools/` 下的开发脚本随包一起发布（`files` 里有它），克隆仓库或装 npm 包都能拿到：

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · 开发：| 脚本 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `tools/test.cjs` | 全量测试 + 一致性守卫 |
| `tools/sync-to-plugin.cjs` | 项目 `lib/` → 已安装插件目录 |
| `tools/sync-from-plugin.cjs` | 已安装插件目录 → 项目 `lib/` |
| `tools/plugin-dir.cjs` | 自动定位插件目录 |
| `tools/shot.cjs` | 生成 README 截图 |

它们只在开发时用，插件运行时不会加载。`npm test` 需要仓库里的 `tests/` 目录，
所以从 npm 装的包只能跑 `sync-*` / `shot` 这几个。

插件目录的位置自动探测，顺序是：环境变量 `DSH_STATUS_BAR_PLUGIN_DIR` → `~/.dsh` 下的已知安装布局
（`local-plugins/`、各 `profiles/*/node_modules/`）→ 由 `tools/` 位置推导。换机器、换用户名都不用改代码。

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Introduction：

中文 | English

Replaces the stats line under the message input in the DSH desktop app with a configurable status bar: fields, ordering, per-model prices and currency are all configurable, with live cost estimates using DeepSeek's official peak/off-peak rates.

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Features：- **9 optional fields plus the context ring**: context occupancy (the ring at the head of the bar), peak / off-peak check, turns & steps, cache hit rate, output speed, TTFT, run time, this turn cost, session cost, balance
- **Click a field for details**:

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Features：| Field | Content |
  | --- | --- |
  | Context ring (bar head) | System prompt / tool definitions / messages |
  | Peak / off-peak check | Usage heat map: day / week / month / year |
  | Turns & steps | Context compactions / skills injected / tool calls |
  | Combined hit | This turn / highest / lowest cache hit rate |
  | TPS | This turn / fastest / slowest speed |
  | TTFT | This turn / fastest / slowest first-token delay |
  | Run time | Wait time / model time / tool calls |
  | This turn cost | Token breakdown for this turn |
  | Session cost | Cumulative token breakdown for this session |
  | Balance | Top-up balance / granted balance / quota left |

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Features：- **Session data drill-down**: context compactions mark the node they happened at, skills injected counts the skills injected in this session, and tool calls list every tool the session used with its call count; click the title to go back up
- **Version check and update**: DSH checks for the latest version on startup, shows a hint next to the "Status bar" nav item when one is available, and offers a one-click update button in settings
- **GitHub support**: your support is the biggest motivation for the developer to keep going! Click the button to open the GitHub project page and help with a star — thanks, everyone!
- **Cost estimation**: priced with the official peak/off-peak rules; each call is computed from the moment it happened and the model it used
- **Price book**: your own prices, an optional peak/off-peak split, and a CNY / USD currency switch
- **Also**: one-click holiday calendar update, balance refreshed every minute, bilingual UI

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Install：In the DSH desktop app, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and install by package name:

```
dsh-desktop-statusbar
```

Where the npm registry is not reachable, the same dialog offers the China mainland mirror as the install source. A GitHub repository URL is also accepted:

```
https://github.com/raphael-y7/dsh-desktop-statusbar
```

Command line:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-desktop-statusbar
```

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Install from npm：Both ways above install from the npm registry; the package name is `dsh-desktop-statusbar`. To check the current version on npm:

```powershell
npm view dsh-desktop-statusbar version
```

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · When the built-in updater fails：The one-click update button inside the plugin can fail on some desktop builds — it either does nothing or reports a failure. Do not keep clicking it. Use the official install entry instead and **append `@version` to the package name** to pin the exact version:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-desktop-statusbar@3.0.0
```

The same string works in the plugin panel — type `dsh-desktop-statusbar@3.0.0` into the **Add plugin** field.

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · When the built-in updater fails：Use whatever version you see (the version on the release page, or the output of the `npm view` command above). Pinning the version has a second benefit: **you get exactly the build you asked for**, with no chance of a stale cached package.

Also listed on [dshmarket](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/raphael-y7/dsh-desktop-statusbar/), [dshfind](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/raphael-y7/dsh-desktop-statusbar) and [1024Store](https://deepseek1024.com/plugins/Rapheal-Y7/dsh-desktop-statusbar).

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Usage：- **Context occupancy**: the ring at the head of the bar — progress shows the share of context used, the gap marks the compaction threshold, and the colour shows the run state (grey idle / green running / red error / amber pending approval)
- **Stats fields**: ticking controls visibility only, so unticking hides a field without moving it; drag the handle on the right to reorder; "Reset settings" restores the factory order
- **Custom model prices**: enter a model name and "Add" to create an entry; "Edit" opens the editor and changes are written on save; tick "peak / off-peak pricing" to split by time of day, otherwise a flat all-day price applies
- **Currency**: CNY or USD in the top-right corner of the editor. Switching replaces the two built-in models with that currency's official reference prices (edited entries are kept) and changes the symbol in the cost fields; the balance follows the currency reported by the API
- **Holidays**: click "Update holidays" to fetch and write the next year's public-holiday calendar
- **Balance**: refreshed once a minute

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Billing rules：Peak hours are **09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, Monday to Friday**, and off-peak rates are half the peak rates; Chinese public holidays and weekends are billed off-peak all day (matching the [official docs](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing), checked 2026-09).

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Known limitations：- Fastest / slowest TTFT and speed come from a new host-side projection: **you must fully quit and restart DSH** before it starts collecting
- A model with no price is not billed; adding the price back-fills its earlier calls
- One-click update relies on `pnpm`: the desktop app uses the copy bundled with the host, while CLI / web usage needs `pnpm` on the system. If neither is found, the update says so explicitly **and logs every location it tried**; you can also point it at a specific command with the `DSH_DESKTOP_STATUSBAR_PNPM` environment variable

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Development：Every test is a standalone script meant to be run with plain node — no test framework.

```powershell
npm test          # runs every verify*.js under tests/, then checks project vs installed plugin dir
npm run sync      # copies lib/ into the installed plugin dir
```

Development scripts under `tools/` ship with the package (the `files` field includes them),
so both a git clone and an npm install get them:

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Development：| Script | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `tools/test.cjs` | full test run + consistency guard |
| `tools/sync-to-plugin.cjs` | project `lib/` → installed plugin dir |
| `tools/sync-from-plugin.cjs` | installed plugin dir → project `lib/` |
| `tools/plugin-dir.cjs` | locates the plugin dir |
| `tools/shot.cjs` | regenerates the README screenshots |

dsh-desktop-statusbar README · Development：They are only used while developing; the plugin never loads them at runtime.
`npm test` needs the repository's `tests/` directory, so an npm-installed copy can only run
`sync-*` and `shot`.

The plugin directory is located automatically: environment variable `DSH_STATUS_BAR_PLUGIN_DIR` →
known layouts under `~/.dsh` (`local-plugins/`, each `profiles/*/node_modules/`) → derived from the
`tools/` location. No code changes needed when switching machine or user name.
